verdict.rationale: Unity's Asset Database and public scripting API are documented (unity-docs-11, unity-docs-12, unity-docs-29) and the editor can be extended with custom inspectors/property drawers (unity-docs-10), which together enable custom import automation, but the evidence never names the actual import-hook mechanism (AssetPostprocessor) or the Presets system that technical artists use to automate imports without hand-clicking each asset. missing for 10: explicit docs on AssetPostprocessor import callbacks, Preset asset application, and example pipeline scripts automating batch imports.
